class.name: Box3DSurfaceMap
class.description: [Box3DSurfaceMap] stores a small palette of surface material ids plus one byte per mesh triangle indexing into it, for mesh collision shapes. The palette holds ids rather than names because this is baked data that outlives authoring. A material's name is an editable label, so a map that stored names lost its references the moment a material was renamed; slot ids are permanent and survive a rename. Use [method Box3DPhysics.surface] to reach a material from an id.

members.member: Surface material ids indexed by [member triangle_indices]. [code]0[/code] means the default material.
One byte per mesh triangle, indexing [member material_ids].
